# Changes to vendored code

Third-party code in `vendor/` is kept as released, except for the patches listed here.

| File | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `lzma/CpuArch.h` | Adds a `__TINYC__` branch that defines `MY_CPU_pragma_pack_push_1` and `MY_CPU_pragma_pop` as empty. | tcc 0.9.27 does not support `_Pragma`. The SDK's own comment says the pack pragma is not needed on most compilers. |
| `lzma/CpuArch.c` | Adds `z7_x86_cpuid_subFunc` to the "unsupported cpuid" branch, as a stub returning zeros. | That branch, which tcc compiles, lacked the function, so linking failed. |
| `lzma/*.h` | All headers from `C/` of 7-Zip 24.09 are copied, including ones whose `.c` files are not compiled. | Some compiled files include them. |
| `libvpx/vpx_config.h`, `vpx_config.c`, `vp9_rtcd.h`, `vpx_dsp_rtcd.h`, `vpx_scale_rtcd.h`, `vpx_version.h` | Generated by libvpx's `configure --target=generic-gnu --disable-vp8 --disable-vp9-encoder --enable-vp9-decoder --disable-vp9-highbitdepth --disable-runtime-cpu-detect --enable-multithread` (plus `--disable-examples --disable-tools --disable-docs --disable-unit-tests --disable-webm-io --disable-libyuv`) and kept at the library root. | libvpx ships no prebuilt config; these select plain C code for every CPU. |
| `libvpx/vpx_config.h` | `CONFIG_MULTITHREAD` is 0 under `__TINYC__` and `__EMSCRIPTEN__`; `HAVE_PTHREAD_H` and `HAVE_UNISTD_H` are 0 under `_WIN32`; under `__TINYC__`, `static_assert(e, m)` is defined as empty when missing. | tcc and the web build run the decoder single-threaded; Windows uses libvpx's native Win32 thread wrapper instead of winpthreads; tcc 0.9.27 has no `static_assert`. |
| `libvpx/vpx_util/vpx_pthread.h` | Includes `<errno.h>` in the Win32 branch. | That branch returns `EBUSY` without including the header that defines it. |
| `libvpx/` | Only the VP9 decoder's 48 `.c` files and the headers they include are copied. | The encoder, VP8, assembly and tools are not used. |
| `opus/` | Only the decoder side is copied: 17 CELT, 44 SILK (fixed-point decoder) and 5 `src/` files, plus the headers they include. | The encoder, DNN/DRED and SIMD code are not used. |

Versions:

| Library | Version |
|---|---|
| SDL2 | 2.32.10 (source tarball) |
| miniz | 3.0.2 |
| bzip2 | 1.0.8 |
| LZMA SDK | the `C/` folder of 7-Zip 24.09 |
| zstd | 1.5.6 (`lib/` only) |
| stb_image, stb_truetype, stb_vorbis | `nothings/stb` master |
| dr_mp3, dr_flac, dr_wav | `mackron/dr_libs` master |
| pl_mpeg | master |
| nanosvg | master |
| nestegg | git `767aab2` (github.com/mozilla/nestegg): `src/nestegg.c` and `include/nestegg/nestegg.h` only |
| libvpx | v1.17.0, VP9 decoder only, generic C |
| libopus | v1.6.1, float build, decoder only |
